export_description: Save the self-assessment as an Excel file for later use.
organization_description: Adding additional information about the organization and assessment is voluntary. However, they support the long-term use of self-assessment.
intro_welcome_title: Welcome to the Cybersecurity Self-Assessment Tool
intro_assessment_tool_text: We do not collect any information you provide in the form. Information about the organization and assessment is processed and stored only in your browser. You can delete all the information you have provided from your browser
intro_browser_history_text: page or by clearing your browser history.
intro_device_warning: Do not use a publicly accessible device for the assessment.
intro_about_text: This tool is designed to help organizations assess and develop their cybersecurity level and comply with cybersecurity law requirements. The self-assessment tool is based on the comprehensive
intro_about_sections_text: The self-assessment consists of multiple sections that cover key administrative cybersecurity perspectives. Each section contains practices that, when assessed for compliance, give you an understanding of your organization's current cybersecurity status and development areas.
intro_how_step1: Add organization information and select an appropriate self-assessment model.
intro_how_step2: Go through each assessment section in order.
intro_how_step3: You can use the guidelines on the section page while making the assessment.
intro_how_step4: Answer the practices honestly according to your organization's current situation.
intro_how_step5: You can skip practices and return to them later.
intro_how_step6: You can add notes to practices to clarify your answer and help plan any follow-up actions.
intro_how_step7: You can mark practices as development targets. Development targets can be practices requiring closer examination, practices to be developed next, or practices that require decision-making by company management.
intro_after_step1: You will see the assessment results.
intro_after_step2: You can download your assessment as an Excel file for later use.
report_complete_results_message: Viewing complete results requires that you respond to the implementation of all practices.
models_description: All assessment models are based on the comprehensive <cybermeterLink>Cybermeter</cybermeterLink> tool assessment model developed by Traficom's <ncscLink>National Cyber Security Centre</ncscLink>. The available models are different variations of Cybermeter's basic model and offer options for different needs and industries.
models_select_description: Choose the model that best suits your organization.
models_cannot_change: You cannot change the assessment model during the assessment. If you want to change the model, first delete the assessment responses on the
intro_mapping_disclaimer_first: The cross-references provided in the tool
intro_mapping_disclaimer_text: to recommendations, standards, and criteria are indicative. Cross-referenced sections may differ, for example in scope, and are therefore not necessarily identical in content.
